speaker: Doctor

The oxygen saturation is concerning at 92%. Is the shortness of breath worse when you lie down or only when you are active? Also, have you noticed any fever or chills recently?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Bilateral interstitial infiltrates suggestive of pulmonary fibrosis. No pleural effusion or pneumothorax observed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Given the bilateral interstitial infiltrates on the X-ray, have you noticed a gradual decline in lung capacity over many years, or did this start suddenly after a specific incident? Additionally, do you have any history of asbestos exposure or other environmental toxins?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Reduced FVC and FEV1 with a normal FEV1/FVC ratio, indicating a restrictive pattern.

speaker: Doctor

REQUEST TEST: High_Resolution_CT (HRCT)

DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF)
